_note: Run HUD layout (src/ui/run_hud.gd): margins, heart scale, panel widths, boss bar, skill slot size (px) and gap. Skill names and icons come from assets/data/hero_skills.json.

skill_bar._note: Slim skill bar (src/ui/skill_bar.gd), crypt and story worlds: slot size, gap, distance to the bottom edge, padding, icon size, key/number/label font sizes, EXP line height (px). hint_cell / hint_alpha: the dim flask in an empty quick-potion slot (H/G), its cell size in px and its opacity.
